definitions.explanation: The name given to a work such as a book, movie, or song.
A position or distinction held as champion in a competition.

examples.english: What is the title of this movie?

examples.japanese: タイトル⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: I understood the content just by looking at the title.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧タイトル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}せなくて→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧、⟦{書店|しょてん}→書店：04205_shoten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't remember the title of the book and had trouble finding it at the bookstore.

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タイトル{戦|せん}→タイトル戦：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}って→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{連覇|れんぱ}→連覇：06573_renpa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: He won last year's title match and is aiming for a consecutive championship this year too.

notes:
From English "title." Used for both the name of a creative work and for championship titles in sports and competitions.
